Median XL replaces the items of classic Diablo II: new base items in six quality tiers, new uniques, sets and runewords, more gems and runes, and many new cube recipes.

* [[Base items]]: the weapons, armour and class-specific items, in six tiers.
* [[Armor looks]]: how each piece of armour changes your character's look.
* [[Unique items]]: the tiered and sacred uniques, and where they drop.
* [[Set items]]: Median XL's sets for advanced characters and their bonuses.
* [[Runewords]]: single-rune runewords and the item types they need.
* [[Gemwords]]: words made with gems instead of runes.
* [[Gems and runes]]: what each gem and rune gives in weapons, armour and shields.
* [[Special items]]: charms, elixirs, quest items, cube reagents and other items that fit no other list.
* [[Horadric Cube]]: the cube recipes, from upgrades to crafting.
